method: Targeted, non-random agent audit of 15 apps across all 10 categories (five fields each). Fourteen apps were checked by a different research agent; GitHub was rechecked by its original agent and is labeled same_agent. The separate human-review sample is randomized within category with a fixed seed. Unknown MCP findings newly resolved by sources are evidence enrichments, not prior false absence claims. Before/after ratios measure documented support within these 75 agent judgments, not population accuracy. No human reviewer or authenticated API test is claimed.
